name: kiln-team-smoke-worker
description: Trivial teammate sub-worker for the team E2E smoke test: writes a stamped file from its injected assignment id.

steps.instruction: Your teammate assignment (injected by wheel) includes an `id` value (e.g. a or b). Write a file at `.wheel/outputs/team-smoke-<id>.txt` containing the single line `worker <id> ran`. Then emit {"id":"<id>","done":true}. Keep it to one action.
